elements.name: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
elements.desc: Some barbarians hail from cultures that revere their ancestors. These tribes teach that warriors of the past linger as mighty spirits who guide and protect the living.

elements.name: Ancestral Protectors
elements.desc: Starting at 3rd level, when you enter your rage, spectral warriors appear. While raging, the first creature you hit with an attack on your turn becomes their target. Until the start of your next turn, that target has disadvantage on any attack roll that isn't against you, and when it hits a creature other than you with an attack, that creature has resistance to the damage dealt. Ends early if your rage ends.

elements.name: Spirit Shield
elements.desc: At 6th level, if you are raging and another creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by 2d6. At 10th level this becomes 3d6, and at 14th level 4d6.

elements.name: Consult the Spirits
elements.desc: At 10th level, you can cast augury or clairvoyance without using a spell slot or material components. This clairvoyance invisibly summons one of your ancestral spirits to the chosen location. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

elements.name: Vengeful Ancestors
elements.desc: At 14th level, when you use Spirit Shield to reduce the damage of an attack, the attacker takes an amount of force damage equal to the damage prevented.

elements.name: Path of the Storm Herald
elements.desc: Barbarians who follow this path learn to transform their rage into a mantle of primal magic.

elements.name: Storm Aura
elements.desc: Starting at 3rd level, you emanate a stormy aura while raging (10 ft., not through total cover). Your aura's effect activates when you enter your rage, and again on each of your turns as a bonus action. Saving throws against your aura use DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. Choose one environment (changeable on level-up):

elements.name: Storm Aura (Desert)
elements.desc: When activated, all other creatures in your aura take 2 fire damage each. Increases to 3 at 5th level, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, and 6 at 20th.

elements.name: Storm Aura (Sea)
elements.desc: When activated, choose one other creature you can see in your aura. It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d6 lightning damage on a failure, or half on a success. Increases to 2d6 at 10th, 3d6 at 15th, 4d6 at 20th.

elements.name: Storm Aura (Tundra)
elements.desc: When activated, each creature of your choice in your aura gains 2 temporary hit points. Increases to 3 at 5th level, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th.

elements.name: Storm Soul
elements.desc: At 6th level, the storm grants you benefits even when your aura isn't active, based on your chosen environment:

elements.name: Storm Soul (Desert)
elements.desc: You have resistance to fire damage and don't suffer extreme heat. As an action, you can touch a flammable object that isn't worn or carried and set it on fire.

elements.name: Storm Soul (Sea)
elements.desc: You have resistance to lightning damage, can breathe underwater, and have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

elements.name: Storm Soul (Tundra)
elements.desc: You have resistance to cold damage and don't suffer extreme cold. As an action, you can touch water and turn a 5-foot cube of it into ice (melts after 1 minute).

elements.name: Shielding Storm
elements.desc: At 10th level, each creature of your choice has the damage resistance you gained from Storm Soul while it is in your Storm Aura.

elements.name: Raging Storm
elements.desc: At 14th level, the power of the storm you channel grows mightier. The effect depends on your chosen environment:

elements.name: Raging Storm (Desert)
elements.desc: Immediately after a creature in your aura hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to force it to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes fire damage equal to half your barbarian level.

elements.name: Raging Storm (Sea)
elements.desc: When you hit a creature in your aura with an attack, you can use your reaction to force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is knocked prone.

elements.name: Raging Storm (Tundra)
elements.desc: When your Storm Aura activates, choose one creature you can see in the aura. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw or its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn.

elements.name: Path of the Zealot
elements.desc: Some deities inspire their followers to pitch themselves into a ferocious battle fury. These barbarians are zealots.

elements.name: Divine Fury
elements.desc: While raging, the first creature you hit each turn with a weapon attack takes extra damage equal to 1d6 + half your barbarian level. The damage is necrotic or radiant (choose when you take this feature).

elements.name: Warrior of the Gods
elements.desc: At 3rd level, if a spell such as raise dead has the sole effect of restoring you to life (but not undeath), the caster doesn't need material components.

elements.name: Fanatical Focus
elements.desc: At 6th level, if you fail a saving throw while raging, you can reroll it and must use the new roll. Once per rage.

elements.name: Zealous Presence
elements.desc: At 10th level, as a bonus action you unleash a battle cry. Up to ten other creatures of your choice within 60 ft. that can hear you gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn.

elements.name: Rage Beyond Death
elements.desc: At 14th level, while raging you don't fall unconscious at 0 hit points. You still make death saving throws and suffer normal effects of damage at 0 HP. If you would die from failing death saves, you don't die until your rage ends, and only if you still have 0 hit points.

elements.name: College of Glamour
elements.desc: Bards who mastered their craft in the Feywild or under its tutelage, using magic to delight and captivate.

elements.name: Mantle of Inspiration
elements.desc: As a bonus action, expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to grant yourself a wondrous appearance. Choose up to your Charisma modifier creatures (min 1) you can see within 60 ft. that can see you. Each gains 5 temporary HP and can immediately use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. THP increase to 8 at 5th level, 11 at 10th, 14 at 15th.

elements.name: Enthralling Performance
elements.desc: If you perform for at least 1 minute, at the end of the performance choose up to your Charisma modifier humanoids (min 1) within 60 ft. that watched and listened to all of it. Each must succeed on a Wisdom save vs. your spell save DC or be charmed by you for 1 hour (idolizes you, speaks glowingly, hinders opponents, avoids violence). A target that succeeds has no hint you tried.

elements.name: Mantle of Majesty
elements.desc: At 6th level, as a bonus action you cast command without expending a spell slot, and take on an appearance of unearthly beauty for 1 minute or until your concentration ends. During that time, you can cast command as a bonus action on each of your turns without expending a spell slot. Any creature charmed by you automatically fails its saving throw against the command you cast with this feature.

elements.name: Unbreakable Majesty
elements.desc: At 14th level, as a bonus action you can assume a magically majestic presence for 1 minute or until incapacitated. Whenever any creature tries to attack you for the first time on a turn, it must make a Charisma save vs. your spell save DC. On a failure, it can't attack you this turn and must choose a new target or the attack is wasted. On a success, it can attack you, but has disadvantage on saving throws against your spells on your next turn.

elements.name: College of Swords
elements.desc: Bards called blades who entertain through daring feats of weapon prowess.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiencies
elements.desc: When you join the College of Swords at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with medium armor and the scimitar. If you're proficient with a simple or martial melee weapon, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your bard spells.

elements.name: Fighting Style
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you adopt a style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one (Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting only; can't take the same option twice):

elements.name: Blade Flourish
elements.desc: At 3rd level, when you take the Attack action, your walking speed increases by 10 ft. until the end of the turn, and if a weapon attack that is part of that action hits, you can use one Blade Flourish (once per turn): Defensive Flourish (spend one Bardic Inspiration; weapon deals extra damage equal to the die roll, and you add the roll to your AC until the start of your next turn); Slashing Flourish (spend one Bardic Inspiration; the hit target and one other creature you can see within 5 ft. of you both take extra damage equal to the die roll); Mobile Flourish (spend one Bardic Inspiration; extra damage equal to the die roll, and you can push the target up to 5 ft. + the die roll away; you can then use your reaction to move up to your speed toward it).

elements.name: Extra Attack
elements.desc: Starting at 6th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

elements.name: Master's Flourish
elements.desc: At 14th level, whenever you use a Blade Flourish option, you can roll a d6 and use it instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die.

elements.name: College of Whispers
elements.desc: Bards who use their knowledge and magic to uncover secrets and turn them against others.

elements.name: Psychic Blades
elements.desc: At 3rd level, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to deal extra psychic damage: 2d6 (3d6 at 5th level, 5d6 at 10th, 8d6 at 15th). Once per round on your turn.

elements.name: Words of Terror
elements.desc: At 3rd level, if you speak to a humanoid alone for at least 1 minute, at the end of the conversation the target must succeed on a Wisdom save vs. your spell save DC or be frightened of you or another creature of your choice for 1 hour (or until attacked/damaged, or until it witnesses its allies being attacked/damaged). A successful target has no hint you tried.

elements.name: Mantle of Whispers
elements.desc: At 6th level, when a humanoid dies within 30 ft. of you, you can use your reaction to capture its shadow. You retain the shadow until you use it or finish a long rest. Use it as an action to adopt the person's appearance (healthy and alive) for 1 hour or until you end it as a bonus action. You gain access to general details on its background and personal life (but no secrets). Another creature can see through the disguise with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check vs. your Charisma (Deception) check, with you gaining +5 to your check.

elements.name: Shadow Lore
elements.desc: At 14th level, as an action you whisper a phrase that only one creature of your choice within 30 ft. can hear. It must make a Wisdom save vs. your spell save DC (auto-succeeds if it can't hear or share a language). On a failure it is charmed by you for 8 hours or until you or your allies attack, damage, or force it to make a saving throw. It interprets the whisper as a description of its most mortifying secret and obeys your commands out of fear, without risking its life. When the effect ends, it has no understanding of why it feared you.

elements.name: Forge Domain
elements.desc: Gods of the forge are patrons of artisans who work with metal.

rules.grant: Class Feature:Saint of Forge and Fire

elements.name: Domain Spells
elements.desc: You gain domain spells at the cleric levels listed. See the Divine Domain class feature for how domain spells work.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiency
elements.desc: At 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor and smith's tools.

elements.name: Blessing of the Forge
elements.desc: At 1st level, at the end of a long rest you can touch one nonmagical suit of armor or simple or martial weapon. Until the end of your next long rest or until you die, it becomes a magic item: +1 AC if armor, or +1 to attack and damage rolls if a weapon.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
elements.desc: Starting at 2nd level, you can conduct an hour-long ritual to craft a nonmagical item that includes some metal (simple or martial weapon, suit of armor, ten pieces of ammunition, set of tools, or another metal object). The item must be worth no more than 100 gp. You must lay out metal (which can include coins) with value equal to the creation; it is consumed. The ritual can duplicate a nonmagical metal item if you possess the original.

elements.name: Soul of the Forge
elements.desc: At 6th level, you gain resistance to fire damage. While wearing heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

elements.name: Divine Strike
elements.desc: At 8th level, once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 fire damage. At 14th level this becomes 2d8.

elements.id: Class Feature:Saint of Forge and Fire
elements.name: Saint of Forge and Fire
elements.desc: At 17th level, you gain immunity to fire damage, and while wearing heavy armor you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

elements.name: Grave Domain
elements.desc: Gods of the grave watch over the line between life and death.

rules.grant: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave

elements.name: Domain Spells
elements.desc: You gain domain spells at the cleric levels listed. See the Divine Domain class feature for how domain spells work.

elements.name: Circle of Mortality
elements.desc: At 1st level, when you would normally roll dice to restore HP with a spell to a creature at 0 HP, you instead use the highest number possible for each die. Additionally, you learn the spare the dying cantrip (doesn't count against cleric cantrips known); for you it has a range of 30 ft. and can be cast as a bonus action.

elements.name: Eyes of the Grave
elements.desc: At 1st level, as an action you can open your awareness to magically detect undead. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any undead within 60 ft. of you that isn't behind total cover and isn't protected from divination magic. This sense doesn't reveal capabilities or identity.

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
elements.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
elements.desc: Starting at 2nd level, as an action you can choose one creature you can see within 30 ft. and curse it until the end of your next turn. The next time you or an ally hits the cursed creature with an attack, it has vulnerability to all of that attack's damage, and then the curse ends.

elements.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
elements.desc: At 6th level, as a reaction when you or a creature you can see within 30 ft. suffers a critical hit, you can turn that hit into a normal hit. Any effects triggered by the critical are canceled. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (min 1), regained on a long rest.

elements.name: Potent Spellcasting
elements.desc: At 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

elements.name: Keeper of Souls
elements.desc: At 17th level, when an enemy you can see dies within 60 ft. of you, you or one creature of your choice within 60 ft. regains HP equal to the enemy's number of Hit Dice. Once per turn; you can't use it if you're incapacitated.

elements.name: Circle of Dreams
elements.desc: Druids who hail from regions with strong ties to the Feywild and its dreamlike realms.

rules.grant: Class Feature:Balm of the Summer Court
Class Feature:Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow

elements.id: Class Feature:Balm of the Summer Court
elements.name: Balm of the Summer Court
elements.desc: At 2nd level, you have a pool of fey energy represented by a number of d6s equal to your druid level. As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 120 ft.; spend up to half your druid level dice, roll them, and add the total. The target regains that many HP and gains 1 temporary HP per die spent. Regain all expended dice on a long rest.

elements.id: Class Feature:Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
elements.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
elements.desc: At 6th level, at the start of a short or long rest you can touch a point in space and create an invisible 30-ft.-radius sphere. Total cover blocks the sphere. While within, you and your allies gain +5 to Dexterity (Stealth) and Wisdom (Perception) checks, and open flames inside aren't visible outside. The sphere vanishes at the end of the rest or when you leave it.

elements.name: Hidden Paths
elements.desc: At 10th level, as a bonus action you can teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see. Alternatively, as an action you can teleport a willing creature you touch up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (min 1), regained on a long rest.

elements.name: Walker in Dreams
elements.desc: At 14th level, when you finish a short rest you can cast dream (with you as messenger), scrying, or teleportation circle without expending a spell slot or material components. This teleportation circle opens a portal to the last location where you finished a long rest on your current plane (if you haven't, the spell fails but isn't wasted).

elements.name: Circle of the Shepherd
elements.desc: Druids who commune with spirits of nature, especially of beasts and fey.

elements.name: Speech of the Woods
elements.desc: At 2nd level, you learn to speak, read, and write Sylvan. Beasts can understand your speech, and you can decipher their noises and motions.

elements.name: Spirit Totem
elements.desc: At 2nd level, as a bonus action you can summon an incorporeal nature spirit to a point you can see within 60 ft. It creates a 30-ft.-radius aura; it counts as neither creature nor object. As a bonus action, you can move it up to 60 ft. It persists 1 minute or until you're incapacitated. Once used, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest. When summoned, choose one spirit: Bear (each creature of your choice in the aura gains 5 + druid level temp HP, and you and your allies have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saves while in the aura), Hawk (when a creature makes an attack roll against a target in the aura, you can use your reaction to grant it advantage; you and your allies have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks while in the aura), or Unicorn (you and your allies have advantage on all checks to detect creatures in the aura; when you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores HP to any creature inside or outside the aura, each creature of your choice in the aura also regains HP equal to your druid level).

elements.name: Mighty Summoner
elements.desc: At 6th level, any beast or fey summoned or created by a spell you cast gains 2 extra HP per Hit Die and its natural weapon damage is considered magical.

elements.name: Guardian Spirit
elements.desc: At 10th level, when a beast or fey you summoned or created with a spell ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura, it regains HP equal to half your druid level.

elements.name: Faithful Summons
elements.desc: At 14th level, if you are reduced to 0 HP or are incapacitated against your will, you can immediately gain the benefits of conjure animals as if cast with a 9th-level slot (four CR 2 or lower beasts of your choice, appearing within 20 ft., lasting 1 hour with no concentration or until dismissed).

elements.name: Arcane Archer
elements.desc: An elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks.

elements.name: Arcane Archer Lore
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in either Arcana or Nature, and you learn either the prestidigitation or the druidcraft cantrip.

elements.name: Arcane Shot
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you learn two Arcane Shot options of your choice. Once per turn when you fire an arrow from a shortbow or longbow as part of the Attack action, you can apply one option. You decide when the arrow hits (unless the option doesn't involve an attack roll). You have two uses, regained on a short or long rest. You learn another option at 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level. Saving throws use DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier.

elements.name: Magic Arrow
elements.desc: At 7th level, whenever you fire a nonmagical arrow from a shortbow or longbow, you can make it magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage. The magic fades immediately after the arrow hits or misses.

elements.name: Curving Shot
elements.desc: At 7th level, when you make an attack roll with a magic arrow and miss, you can use a bonus action to reroll the attack against a different target within 60 ft. of the original.

elements.name: Ever-Ready Shot
elements.desc: At 15th level, if you roll initiative and have no uses of Arcane Shot remaining, you regain one use.

elements.name: Banishing Arrow
elements.desc: A creature hit by the arrow must make a Charisma save or be banished to a harmless location in the Feywild. While banished, its speed is 0 and it's incapacitated. It returns at the end of its next turn. At 18th level, it also takes an extra 2d6 force damage on hit.

elements.name: Beguiling Arrow
elements.desc: A creature hit by the arrow takes an extra 2d6 psychic damage, and one ally of your choice within 30 ft. of the target forces it to make a Wisdom save or be charmed by that ally until the start of your next turn. At 18th level, the psychic damage becomes 4d6.

elements.name: Bursting Arrow
elements.desc: Immediately after the arrow hits, the target and each other creature within 10 ft. of it take 2d6 force damage. At 18th level, this becomes 4d6.

elements.name: Enfeebling Arrow
elements.desc: A creature hit by the arrow takes an extra 2d6 necrotic damage and must make a Constitution save or have its weapon damage halved until the start of your next turn. At 18th level, the necrotic damage becomes 4d6.

elements.name: Grasping Arrow
elements.desc: A creature hit by the arrow takes an extra 2d6 poison damage, its speed is reduced by 10 ft., and it takes 2d6 slashing damage the first time each turn it moves 1 ft. or more without teleporting. It or another creature within reach can use an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check vs. your Arcane Shot DC to remove the brambles, which otherwise last 1 minute or until you use this option again. At 18th level, both the poison and slashing damage become 4d6.

elements.name: Piercing Arrow
elements.desc: When you use this option, you make no attack roll. The arrow shoots forward in a 1-ft.-wide, 30-ft.-long line, passing harmlessly through objects and ignoring cover. Each creature in that line makes a Dexterity save. On a failure it takes damage as if hit by the arrow plus an extra 1d6 piercing damage; on a success, half damage. At 18th level, the extra damage becomes 2d6.

elements.name: Seeking Arrow
elements.desc: When you use this option, you make no attack roll. Choose one creature you have seen in the past minute. The arrow flies toward it, moving around corners if necessary and ignoring three-quarters cover and half cover. If the target is within weapon range and a path exists, it must make a Dexterity save. On a failure it takes damage as if hit by the arrow plus an extra 1d6 force damage, and you learn its location. On a success it takes half damage. At 18th level, the extra damage becomes 2d6.

elements.name: Shadow Arrow
elements.desc: A creature hit by the arrow takes an extra 2d6 psychic damage and must make a Wisdom save or be unable to see anything beyond 5 ft. until the start of your next turn. At 18th level, the psychic damage becomes 4d6.

elements.name: Cavalier
elements.desc: A fighter who excels at mounted combat and guarding others.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiency
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in one of Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiency (Cavalier - Skill)
elements.desc: You gain proficiency in one of Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiency (Cavalier - Language)
elements.desc: You learn one language of your choice.

elements.name: Born to the Saddle
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you have advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount. If you fall off and descend no more than 10 ft., you land on your feet if not incapacitated. Mounting or dismounting costs only 5 ft. of movement.

elements.name: Unwavering Mark
elements.desc: At 3rd level, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can mark it until the end of your next turn (ends early if you're incapacitated, die, or someone else marks it). While the marked creature is within 5 ft. of you, it has disadvantage on any attack roll that doesn't target you. In addition, if a marked creature deals damage to anyone other than you, you can make a special melee weapon attack against it as a bonus action on your next turn, with advantage and extra damage equal to half your fighter level. Uses equal to your Strength modifier (min 1), regained on a long rest.

elements.name: Warding Maneuver
elements.desc: At 7th level, if you or a creature you can see within 5 ft. of you is hit by an attack and you're wielding a melee weapon or a shield, you can use your reaction to roll 1d8 and add it to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still hits, the target has resistance against the attack's damage. Uses equal to your Constitution modifier (min 1), regained on a long rest.

elements.name: Hold the Line
elements.desc: At 10th level, creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you when they move 5 ft. or more while within your reach, and if you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn.

elements.name: Ferocious Charger
elements.desc: At 15th level, once per turn, if you move at least 10 ft. in a straight line right before attacking a creature and hit it, the target must succeed on a Strength save (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be knocked prone.

elements.name: Vigilant Defender
elements.desc: At 18th level, you get a special reaction you can take once on every creature's turn (except your own). You can use it only to make an opportunity attack, and you can't use it on the same turn you take your normal reaction.

elements.name: Samurai
elements.desc: A fighter drawing on implacable fighting spirit.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiency
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in one of History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiency (Samurai - Skill)
elements.desc: You gain proficiency in one of History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiency (Samurai - Language)
elements.desc: You learn one language of your choice.

elements.name: Fighting Spirit
elements.desc: At 3rd level, as a bonus action you can give yourself advantage on weapon attack rolls until the end of the current turn, and gain 5 temporary HP (10 at 10th level, 15 at 15th). Three uses, regained on a long rest.

elements.name: Elegant Courtier
elements.desc: At 7th level, whenever you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier. You also gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws; if you already have it, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

elements.name: Tireless Spirit
elements.desc: At 10th level, when you roll initiative and have no uses of Fighting Spirit remaining, you regain one use.

elements.name: Rapid Strike
elements.desc: At 15th level, if you take the Attack action and have advantage on an attack roll against one of the targets, you can forgo the advantage to make an additional weapon attack against that target as part of the same action. Once per turn.

elements.name: Strength Before Death
elements.desc: At 18th level, if you take damage that reduces you to 0 HP and doesn't kill you outright, you can use your reaction to delay falling unconscious and immediately take an extra turn, interrupting the current turn. Normal death-save rules apply during that turn. At the end, you fall unconscious if still at 0 HP.

elements.name: Way of the Drunken Master
elements.desc: Monks who move with the jerky, unpredictable movements of a drunkard.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiencies
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in the Performance skill and with brewer's supplies if you don't already have them.

elements.name: Drunken Technique
elements.desc: At 3rd level, whenever you use Flurry of Blows, you gain the benefit of the Disengage action, and your walking speed increases by 10 ft. until the end of the current turn.

elements.name: Tipsy Sway
elements.desc: At 6th level: Leap to Your Feet — when prone, you can stand up by spending 5 ft. of movement. Redirect Attack — when a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can spend 1 ki point as a reaction to cause that attack to hit one creature of your choice (other than the attacker) within reach.

elements.name: Drunkard's Luck
elements.desc: At 11th level, when you make an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw and have disadvantage, you can spend 2 ki points to cancel the disadvantage for that roll.

elements.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
elements.desc: At 17th level, when you use Flurry of Blows, you can make up to three additional attacks (up to five total), provided each attack targets a different creature that turn.

elements.name: Way of the Kensei
elements.desc: Monks who train relentlessly with weapons until the weapon becomes an extension of the body.

elements.name: Path of the Kensei
elements.desc: At 3rd level: Kensei Weapons (choose one melee and one ranged simple or martial weapon that lacks Heavy and Special — longbow is also valid; you gain proficiency with them, and they are monk weapons for you; choose another at 6th, 11th, and 17th). Agile Parry (if you make an unarmed strike as part of the Attack action and are holding a melee kensei weapon, you gain a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, while the weapon is in hand and you aren't incapacitated). Kensei's Shot (as a bonus action, ranged attacks with a kensei weapon deal an extra 1d4 damage of the weapon's type until end of turn). Way of the Brush (proficiency with calligrapher's supplies or painter's supplies).

elements.name: One with the Blade
elements.desc: At 6th level, attacks with your kensei weapons count as magical. When you hit with a kensei weapon, you can spend 1 ki point to deal extra damage equal to your Martial Arts die (once per turn).

elements.name: Sharpen the Blade
elements.desc: At 11th level, as a bonus action you can expend up to 3 ki points to grant one kensei weapon you touch a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the points spent, for 1 minute. No effect on a magic weapon that already has an attack/damage bonus.

elements.name: Unerring Accuracy
elements.desc: At 17th level, if you miss with an attack roll using a monk weapon on your turn, you can reroll it. Once per turn.

elements.name: Way of the Sun Soul
elements.desc: Monks who learn to channel their life energy into searing bolts of light.

elements.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you gain a new attack option usable with the Attack action: a ranged spell attack with a range of 30 ft., using your Dexterity modifier for attack and damage rolls (proficient), radiant damage, damage die = Martial Arts die. When you take the Attack action and use this special attack as part of it, you can spend 1 ki point to make it twice as a bonus action. Extra Attack applies to this option.

elements.name: Searing Arc Strike
elements.desc: At 6th level, immediately after you take the Attack action, you can spend 2 ki points to cast burning hands as a bonus action. You can spend additional ki points to cast it at higher levels (each extra ki = 1 spell level), up to a maximum of half your monk level ki points spent.

elements.name: Searing Sunburst
elements.desc: At 11th level, as an action you can magically create and hurl an orb of light at a point within 150 ft., where it erupts into a 20-ft.-radius sphere. Each creature in the sphere must make a Constitution save or take 2d6 radiant damage (no save if behind opaque total cover). You can spend up to 3 ki points to increase the damage by 2d6 per point.

elements.name: Sun Shield
elements.desc: At 17th level, you become wreathed in a luminous aura: bright light in a 30-ft. radius and dim light for an additional 30 ft. You can extinguish or restore it as a bonus action. When a creature hits you with a melee attack while the light shines, you can use your reaction to deal 5 + your Wisdom modifier radiant damage to it.

elements.name: Oath of Conquest
elements.desc: Paladins who seek glory in battle and the subjugation of their enemies.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
elements.desc: As an action, you force each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 ft. of you to make a Wisdom save. On a failure, a creature becomes frightened of you for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
elements.desc: When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You choose after seeing the roll but before knowing whether it hits or misses.

elements.name: Aura of Conquest
elements.desc: At 7th level, you constantly emanate a menacing aura (10 ft., not through total cover) while not incapacitated. If a creature frightened of you is in the aura, its speed is 0 while there, and it takes psychic damage equal to half your paladin level if it starts its turn there. At 18th level, the range increases to 30 ft.

elements.name: Scornful Rebuke
elements.desc: At 15th level, whenever a creature hits you with an attack, that creature takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1) if you're not incapacitated.

elements.name: Invincible Conqueror
elements.desc: At 20th level, as an action you can magically become an avatar of conquest for 1 minute, gaining: resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures; one additional attack when you take the Attack action; and melee weapon critical hits on a 19 or 20.

elements.name: Oath of Redemption
elements.desc: Paladins who use violence only as a last resort, believing any person can be redeemed.

rules.grant: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
elements.name: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you grant yourself a +5 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks for the next 10 minutes.

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
elements.name: Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
elements.desc: Immediately after an attacker within 30 ft. of you deals damage with an attack against a creature other than you, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to make a Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes radiant damage equal to the damage it just dealt; on a success, half.

elements.name: Aura of the Guardian
elements.desc: At 7th level, when a creature within 10 ft. of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically take that damage instead. This doesn't transfer other effects, and the damage can't be reduced in any way. At 18th level, the range increases to 30 ft.

elements.name: Protective Spirit
elements.desc: At 15th level, you regain HP equal to 1d6 + half your paladin level if you end your turn in combat with fewer than half your HP remaining and you aren't incapacitated.

elements.name: Emissary of Redemption
elements.desc: At 20th level: resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures; whenever a creature hits you with an attack, it takes radiant damage equal to half the damage you take. If you attack, cast a spell on, or otherwise deal damage to a creature (other than by this feature), neither benefit works against that creature until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Gloom Stalker
elements.desc: Rangers at home in the darkest places, seeking to ambush threats in the shadows.

elements.name: Gloom Stalker Magic
elements.desc: You learn additional spells at the ranger levels listed. They count as ranger spells for you and don't count against your number of ranger spells known. (disguise self 3rd, rope trick 5th, fear 9th, greater invisibility 13th, seeming 17th.)

elements.name: Dread Ambusher
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you gain a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Wisdom modifier. At the start of your first turn of each combat, your walking speed increases by 10 ft. until the end of that turn. If you take the Attack action on that turn, you can make one additional weapon attack as part of that action, dealing an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type on a hit.

elements.name: Umbral Sight
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you gain darkvision out to 60 ft.; if you already have darkvision, its range increases by 30 ft. While in darkness, you are invisible to any creature that relies on darkvision to see you in that darkness.

elements.name: Iron Mind
elements.desc: At 7th level, you gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws; if you already have it, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

elements.name: Stalker's Flurry
elements.desc: At 11th level, once on each of your turns when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

elements.name: Shadowy Dodge
elements.desc: At 15th level, whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you and doesn't have advantage, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on it, before knowing the outcome.

elements.name: Horizon Walker
elements.desc: Rangers who guard the world against otherworldly threats and planar incursions.

elements.name: Horizon Walker Magic
elements.desc: You learn additional spells at the ranger levels listed. They count as ranger spells for you and don't count against your ranger spells known. (protection from evil and good 3rd, misty step 5th, haste 9th, banishment 13th, teleportation circle 17th.)

elements.name: Detect Portal
elements.desc: At 3rd level, as an action you can detect the distance and direction to the closest planar portal within 1 mile of you.

elements.name: Planar Warrior
elements.desc: At 3rd level, as a bonus action choose one creature you can see within 30 ft. The next time you hit it with a weapon attack this turn, all damage becomes force damage and it takes an extra 1d8 force damage. At 11th level, the extra damage becomes 2d8.

elements.name: Ethereal Step
elements.desc: At 7th level, as a bonus action you can cast etherealness with this feature without expending a spell slot, but the spell ends at the end of the current turn.

elements.name: Distant Strike
elements.desc: At 11th level, when you take the Attack action, you can teleport up to 10 ft. before each attack to an unoccupied space you can see. If you attack at least two different creatures with the action, you can make one additional attack against a third creature.

elements.name: Spectral Defense
elements.desc: At 15th level, when you take damage from an attack, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to all of that attack's damage on this turn.

elements.name: Monster Slayer
elements.desc: Rangers dedicated to hunting creatures of the night and wielders of grim magic.

elements.name: Monster Slayer Magic
elements.desc: You learn additional spells at the ranger levels listed. They count as ranger spells for you and don't count against your ranger spells known. (protection from evil and good 3rd, zone of truth 5th, magic circle 9th, banishment 13th, hold monster 17th.)

elements.name: Hunter's Sense
elements.desc: At 3rd level, as an action choose one creature you can see within 60 ft. You immediately learn whether it has any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities and what they are. If it's hidden from divination magic, you sense it has none.

elements.name: Slayer's Prey
elements.desc: At 3rd level, as a bonus action designate one creature you can see within 60 ft. The first time each turn you hit that target with a weapon attack, it takes an extra 1d6 damage. Lasts until you finish a short or long rest or designate a different creature.

elements.name: Supernatural Defense
elements.desc: At 7th level, whenever the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw, and whenever you make an ability check to escape its grapple, add 1d6 to your roll.

elements.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
elements.desc: At 11th level, when you see a creature casting a spell or teleporting within 60 ft. of you, you can use your reaction to try to foil it. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom save vs. your spell save DC, or its spell or teleport fails and is wasted.

elements.name: Slayer's Counter
elements.desc: At 15th level, if the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against it, immediately before the save. If your attack hits, your save automatically succeeds.

elements.name: Inquisitive
elements.desc: Rogues who excel at rooting out secrets and unraveling mysteries.

elements.name: Ear for Deceit
elements.desc: At 3rd level, when you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to determine whether a creature is lying, treat a roll of 7 or lower on the d20 as an 8.

elements.name: Eye for Detail
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you can use a bonus action to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden creature or object, or an Intelligence (Investigation) check to uncover or decipher clues.

elements.name: Insightful Fighting
elements.desc: At 3rd level, as a bonus action you can make a Wisdom (Insight) check against a creature you can see that isn't incapacitated, contested by its Charisma (Deception). On a success, you can use Sneak Attack against that target even without advantage, but not if you have disadvantage. Lasts 1 minute or until you successfully use this on a different target.

elements.name: Steady Eye
elements.desc: At 9th level, you have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

elements.name: Unerring Eye
elements.desc: At 13th level, as an action you can sense the presence of illusions, shapechangers not in their original form, and other magic designed to deceive the senses within 30 ft. of you, provided you aren't blinded or deafened. You sense that an effect is attempting to trick you, but not what or its true nature.

elements.name: Eye for Weakness
elements.desc: At 17th level, while your Insightful Fighting feature applies to a creature, your Sneak Attack damage against that creature increases by 3d6.

elements.name: Scout
elements.desc: Rogues skilled in stealth and survival far from the city.

elements.name: Skirmisher
elements.desc: At 3rd level, when an enemy ends its turn within 5 ft. of you, you can move up to half your speed as a reaction. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

elements.name: Survivalist
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Nature and Survival. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check that uses either of those proficiencies.

elements.name: Superior Mobility
elements.desc: At 9th level, your walking speed increases by 10 ft. If you have a climbing or swimming speed, this increase applies to that speed as well.

elements.name: Ambush Master
elements.desc: At 13th level, you have advantage on initiative rolls. In addition, the first creature you hit during the first round of a combat becomes easier to hit: attack rolls against that target have advantage until the start of your next turn.

elements.name: Sudden Strike
elements.desc: At 17th level, if you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one additional attack as a bonus action. This attack can benefit from Sneak Attack even if you've already used it this turn, but not on the same target.

elements.name: Divine Soul
elements.desc: Sorcerers whose innate magic comes from a divine source.

elements.name: Divine Magic
elements.desc: Your link to the divine lets you learn spells from the cleric class. When your Spellcasting feature lets you learn or replace a sorcerer cantrip or spell, you can choose the new spell from the cleric spell list or the sorcerer spell list. It becomes a sorcerer spell for you. In addition, choose an affinity for the source of your divine power — this grants you one additional spell as shown.

elements.name: Affinity (Good)
elements.desc: You learn the cure wounds spell. It is a sorcerer spell for you but doesn't count against your sorcerer spells known.
featSpells: divine soul affinity spell, sorcerer list

elements.name: Affinity (Evil)
elements.desc: You learn the inflict wounds spell. It is a sorcerer spell for you but doesn't count against your sorcerer spells known.
featSpells: divine soul affinity spell, sorcerer list

elements.name: Affinity (Law)
elements.desc: You learn the bless spell. It is a sorcerer spell for you but doesn't count against your sorcerer spells known.
featSpells: divine soul affinity spell, sorcerer list

elements.name: Affinity (Chaos)
elements.desc: You learn the bane spell. It is a sorcerer spell for you but doesn't count against your sorcerer spells known.
featSpells: divine soul affinity spell, sorcerer list

elements.name: Affinity (Neutrality)
elements.desc: You learn the protection from evil and good spell. It is a sorcerer spell for you but doesn't count against your sorcerer spells known.
featSpells: divine soul affinity spell, sorcerer list

elements.name: Favored by the Gods
elements.desc: At 1st level, if you fail a saving throw or miss with an attack roll, you can roll 2d4 and add it to the total, possibly changing the outcome.

elements.name: Empowered Healing
elements.desc: At 6th level, whenever you or an ally within 5 ft. of you rolls dice to determine HP restored by a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll any number of those dice once, provided you aren't incapacitated. Once per turn.

elements.name: Otherworldly Wings
elements.desc: At 14th level, as a bonus action you can manifest a pair of spectral wings from your back, gaining a flying speed of 30 ft. They last until you're incapacitated, die, or dismiss them as a bonus action. Appearance depends on your Divine Magic affinity (eagle wings for good or law, bat wings for evil or chaos, dragonfly wings for neutrality).

elements.name: Unearthly Recovery
elements.desc: At 18th level, as a bonus action when you have fewer than half your HP remaining, you can regain HP equal to half your HP maximum.

elements.name: Shadow Magic
elements.desc: Sorcerers whose innate magic comes from the Shadowfell.

elements.name: Eyes of the Dark
elements.desc: At 1st level, you have darkvision with a range of 120 ft. At 3rd level, you learn the darkness spell (doesn't count against your sorcerer spells known), and you can cast it by spending 2 sorcery points or by expending a spell slot. If you cast it with sorcery points, you can see through the darkness created by the spell.

elements.name: Strength of the Grave
elements.desc: At 1st level, when damage reduces you to 0 HP, you can make a Charisma save (DC 5 + the damage taken). On a success, you instead drop to 1 HP. You can't use this if you're reduced to 0 by radiant damage or by a critical hit. Once used successfully, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Hound of Ill Omen
elements.desc: At 6th level, as a bonus action you can spend 3 sorcery points to summon a hound of ill omen to target one creature you can see within 120 ft. It uses the dire wolf statistics (Monster Manual) with these changes: size Medium, type monstrosity; temp HP equal to half your sorcerer level; can move through other creatures/objects as difficult terrain (5 force damage if ending turn inside an object); at start of its turn it knows its target's location. The hound appears within 30 ft. of the target; roll initiative; it moves only toward its target and can only attack it (opportunity attacks only against it). While within 5 ft. of the target, the target has disadvantage on saves against any spell you cast. Disappears if reduced to 0 HP, if the target reaches 0 HP, or after 5 minutes.

elements.name: Shadow Walk
elements.desc: At 14th level, when you are in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action you can magically teleport up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

elements.name: Umbral Form
elements.desc: At 18th level, as a bonus action you can spend 6 sorcery points to magically transform into a shadowy form for 1 minute. In this form, you have resistance to all damage except force and radiant, and you can move through other creatures/objects as difficult terrain (5 force damage if ending turn inside an object). Ends early if you're incapacitated, die, or dismiss it as a bonus action.

elements.name: The Celestial
elements.desc: Your patron is a powerful being of the Upper Planes.

elements.name: Bonus Cantrips
elements.desc: At 1st level, you learn the sacred flame and light cantrips. They count as warlock cantrips for you but don't count against your number of cantrips known.

elements.name: Healing Light
elements.desc: At 1st level, you have a pool of d6s equal to 1 + your warlock level. As a bonus action, you can heal one creature you can see within 60 ft., spending dice from the pool. The maximum number of dice you can spend at once equals your Charisma modifier (min 1). Roll the dice, add them, and restore that many HP. Regain all dice on a long rest.

elements.name: Radiant Soul
elements.desc: At 6th level, you have resistance to radiant damage, and when you cast a spell that deals radiant or fire damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to one radiant or fire damage roll of that spell against one of its targets.

elements.name: Celestial Resilience
elements.desc: At 10th level, whenever you finish a short or long rest you gain temporary HP equal to your warlock level + your Charisma modifier, and up to five creatures you can see at the end of the rest each gain temporary HP equal to half your warlock level + your Charisma modifier.

elements.name: Searing Vengeance
elements.desc: At 14th level, when you would make a death saving throw at the start of your turn, you can instead spring back to your feet in a burst of radiant energy: regain HP equal to half your HP maximum, stand up if you choose, and each creature of your choice within 30 ft. takes radiant damage equal to 2d8 + your Charisma modifier and is blinded until the end of the current turn.

elements.name: The Hexblade
elements.desc: Your pact is with a mysterious entity from the Shadowfell that manifests in sentient magic weapons.

elements.name: Hexblade's Curse
elements.desc: At 1st level, as a bonus action choose one creature you can see within 30 ft. The target is cursed for 1 minute (ends early if it dies, you die, or you're incapacitated). Until the curse ends: your damage rolls against it gain a bonus equal to your proficiency bonus; your attack rolls against it score a critical hit on a 19 or 20; and if it dies, you regain HP equal to your warlock level + your Charisma modifier (min 1).

elements.name: Hex Warrior
elements.desc: At 1st level, you gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch one weapon you are proficient with that lacks the two-handed property. When you attack with that weapon, you can use your Charisma modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attack and damage rolls. This lasts until you finish a long rest. If you later gain Pact of the Blade, this benefit extends to every pact weapon you conjure.

elements.name: Accursed Specter
elements.desc: At 6th level, when you slay a humanoid, you can cause its spirit to rise as a specter (Monster Manual). It gains temporary HP equal to half your warlock level and a bonus to its attack rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (min +0). It obeys your verbal commands, rolls its own initiative, and serves until the end of your next long rest.

elements.name: Armor of Hexes
elements.desc: At 10th level, if the target cursed by your Hexblade's Curse hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, the attack instead misses you, regardless of its roll.

elements.name: Master of Hexes
elements.desc: At 14th level, when the creature cursed by your Hexblade's Curse dies, you can apply the curse to a different creature you can see within 30 ft. of you (provided you aren't incapacitated). You don't regain HP from the death of the previously cursed creature when you apply the curse this way.

elements.name: War Magic
elements.desc: A wizardly tradition that blends evocation and abjuration principles to empower spells and bolster defenses.

elements.name: Arcane Deflection
elements.desc: At 2nd level, when you're hit by an attack or you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain a +2 bonus to AC against that attack or a +4 bonus to that saving throw. When you use this feature, you can't cast spells other than cantrips until the end of your next turn.

elements.name: Tactical Wit
elements.desc: At 2nd level, you can give yourself a bonus to initiative rolls equal to your Intelligence modifier.

elements.name: Power Surge
elements.desc: At 6th level, you can store a maximum number of power surges equal to your Intelligence modifier (min 1). Your power surge count resets to one when you finish a long rest. Whenever you successfully end a spell with dispel magic or counterspell, you gain one power surge. If you end a short rest with no power surges, you gain one. Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature or object with a wizard spell, you can spend one power surge to deal extra force damage equal to half your wizard level.

elements.name: Durable Magic
elements.desc: At 10th level, while you maintain concentration on a spell, you have a +2 bonus to AC and all saving throws.

elements.name: Deflecting Shroud
elements.desc: At 14th level, when you use Arcane Deflection, you can cause magical energy to arc from you. Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within 60 ft. of you each take force damage equal to half your wizard level.
